In this role, you will be responsible for managing day-to-day operational tasks to ensure the success of the company's Amazon FBA business.

Your expertise and dedication will contribute to its growth and help achieve its business goals. About the company: SplashEZ, based in the US, originated from a commitment to offer secure and enjoyable water activities for children in hot summers.

Our flagship product, the Splash Sprinkler Pad, became a popular and wet solution catering to diverse age groups. Motivated by our dedication to innovation, we have continued to evolve, expanding our product line to introduce more inventive and engaging water-based products for babies and kids.

Beyond your experience, the company is also looking for someone who embodies an outcome-driven, merit-based approach, combines inventiveness with an open-minded mindset, and can also uphold order and conformity. The company is looking for someone who possesses impeccable written and verbal English communication.

The ideal candidate should be organised, passionate, and have a keen eye for detail and deadlines. Key Responsibilities: Supply Planning Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop accurate reordering forecasts, ensuring optimal inventory levels and on-time deliveries.

Shipping Management: Packing lists Creating shipping plans Coordinate shipments with multiple interfaces, between suppliers Monitor Shipment cycle, preparing meeting deadlines from pick up delivery Reconciliation for inbound inventory to 3PL's and to Amazon Coordinate incoming and outbound shipments Optimizing storage costs by sending "extra" inventory to Amazon Amazon and Inventory Management: Creating shipping labels Amazon shipment reimbursements handling Check Amazon storage fee once a month to ensure correct billing Monitor changes in FBA fees across all products in all marketplaces Managing inventory-related cases with Amazon, including bin checks Submitting CPC Managing documentation of products Procurement and Vendor Management: Creating new products in our internal systems o Setting up new vendors Oversee the creation and management of purchase orders (POs), tracking the entire PO life cycle to ensure timely delivery and compliance.

Managing and negotiate shipments quotations using the bidding process Managing and negotiate 3PL's quotations, finding new warehouses Check master carton size Identifying over fees and overstock inventory for cost-saving opportunities Coordinate and manage relationships with freight forwarders and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to optimize shipping and distribution Qualifications: 3-5 years combined experience in supply chain operations management or startups experience in a similar position in an e-commerce/Amazon seller company Experience working with a start-up company/culture Organisational Skills: Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively are essential.

Communication Skills: Able to communicate thoughts clearly in English written & spoken. Independent Work: The ability to work independently, make decisions with minimal supervision, and a strong sense of initiative are key attributes for this role. Proficient in data analysis and reporting.

Organized, sociable, goal-oriented Would be an added advantage Experience in creating SOPs Management Experience Experience in Vendor Management (Suppliers) Experience with SoStocked Our benefits Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company. Competitive salary. Supportive and friendly work environment.

We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.
This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company's growth.
Our Company
At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that Every Single Patient Matters . This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we’re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.
Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. s.h: What you’ll be doing in this role
s.t:
Supply Chain Strategy, Planning and Operations
Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned to commercial priorities, product launches, lifecycle management and the organisation’s broader growth ambitions.
Provide clear, evidence-based, risk-adjusted recommendations on supply priorities, inventory trade-offs, supplier performance and escalation requirements, enabling timely, transparent and commercially informed decision-making.
Provide strategic oversight of the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing scheduling, distribution and product availability, ensuring a reliable and responsive supply network.
Lead the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, bringing together commercial forecasts, customer demand, inventory strategy and manufacturing capacity to create a clear, aligned view of supply and demand. Proactively identify, communicate and mitigate emerging risks.
Establish and optimise inventory policies and supply strategies that balance product availability, supply resilience, risk and working capital requirements.
Define and maintain meaningful supply chain KPIs and performance measures, using data and insight to identify opportunities, strengthen accountability and drive continuous improvement across the supply network.
Support business development initiatives, new product introductions and other growth initiatives, assessing supply chain requirements and developing scalable, compliant and fit-for-purpose supply solutions.
Own the annual Supply Chain budget, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise costs and deliver value while maintaining regulatory compliance, supply resilience and product availability.
Supply Chain Governance and Operational Excellence
Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging providers, logistics partners, distributors, serialization providers and other critical supply chain partners, ensuring clear accountability and delivery against agreed service, quality and business requirements.
Establish and maintain effective supplier governance, including structured performance reviews, service-level management, quality oversight, issue resolution and improvement plans, ensuring external partners consistently meet expectations.
Work closely with Quality Assurance and relevant functions to ensure the external supply network operates in accordance with applicable GxP, GDP, DSCSA and other regulatory requirements.
Lead the resolution and escalation of complex supply, quality, compliance and operational issues, coordinating internal teams and external partners to minimise business impact and protect product availability.
Drive the development of scalable supply chain processes, improving visibility, data quality, operational efficiency and ways of working as the organisation and product portfolio grow.
Provide governance and oversight of critical supply chain systems and data, including ERP, serialization, GS1 and inventory management platforms, ensuring robust master data, system integrity and reliable reporting.
Establish a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the external supply network, using supplier performance insights, operational data and emerging risks to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.
People Leadership
Lead and develop the Supply Chain function, setting clear priorities, expectations and ways of working while creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.
Build team capability and succession strength through coaching, mentoring and targeted development, ensuring the function has the skills, expertise and capacity to support the organisation’s future growth.
Develop strong, collaborative relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear supply chain insight and challenge to support informed business decisions and representing Supply Chain effectively across cross-functional leadership and governance forums.
The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed in this role:
Degree (or equivalent experience) in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or Life Sciences.
Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships.
Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.

* Align local demand with the Global Supply Chain organisation.

* Good understanding of MRP, production planning, inventory management and logistics processes.
* Strong analytical skills and an advanced level of **Excel**.
* Ability to work across multiple sites and coordinate with different stakeholders.
* Structured, autonomous and solution-oriented approach.
* Comfortable working in an international and cross-functional environment.
* Strong interest in using digital and AI tools to improve operational efficiency.
* **Fluent in both English and French**.

* 2 days of home-office per week.
* A **2-year fixed-term contract** based in Geneva.
* A position with significant cross-functional exposure and responsibility.

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. * Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level
* Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts
* Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders
* Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information
* Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

* Support different processes within Supply Chain
